item.coloph: legs pa'i lam bstan pa'i gtam las ti nge 'dzin gyi yan lag rnam par dag pa zhes bya ba phun sum tshogs pa gsum pa'o/ slob dpon dpa' bos mdzad pa legs pa'i lam bstan pa'i gtam rdzogs so// rgya gar gyi mkhan po dI paM ka ra shrI dz+nyA na dang / lo tsA ba chen po dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ bam po phyed dang gsum mo
